name: git-daily-standup
description: Read your recent commits from a local Git repository and let an LLM turn them into a short standup update, with the commit list attached.

repo.description: Path to a local Git repository (use an absolute path when running from OpenClaw chat)

since.description: How far back to look, in any format git understands: '1 day ago', 'last monday', '2026-10-01'

author.description: Only include commits whose author matches this (name or email). Empty = everyone.

notify_channel.description: Optional OpenClaw channel for the standup (telegram, slack, discord, feishu...)

notify_target.description: Optional chat id / channel id for notify_channel

steps.run: node -e 'const { execFileSync } = require("child_process"); const repo = process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_REPO.replace(/^~(?=\/|$)/, require("os").homedir()); const git = args => execFileSync("git", ["-C", repo, ...args], { encoding: "utf8", maxBuffer: 20e6, stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe"] }).trim(); let name; try { name = require("path").basename(git(["rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"])) } catch (e) { console.error("Not a git repository: " + repo + " (set the repo arg to your project folder)"); process.exit(1) } const branch = git(["rev-parse", "--abbrev-ref", "HEAD"]); const args = ["log", "--all", "--no-merges", "--since=" + process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_SINCE, "--date=format:%a %H:%M", "--pretty=format:%x1e%h%x1f%an%x1f%ad%x1f%s", "--shortstat"]; if (process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_AUTHOR) args.push("--author=" + process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_AUTHOR); const commits = git(args).split("\x1e").map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean).map(block => { const [head, ...rest] = block.split("\n"); const stat = rest.join(" "); const [hash, author, date, subject] = head.split("\x1f"); const n = k => Number((stat.match(new RegExp("(\\d+) " + k)) || [])[1] || 0); return { hash, author, date, subject, files: n("file"), added: n("insertion"), removed: n("deletion") } }); console.log(JSON.stringify({ repo: name, branch, since: process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_SINCE, count: commits.length, commits }))'
printf 'No commits in %s since %s. Nothing to report (or a good day for planning).\n' "$REPO" "$SINCE"

steps.pipeline: llm.invoke --prompt 'Write a short standup update (max 100 words) from these git commits. Format: one line "Done:" followed by 2-5 bullet points that group related commits into outcomes in plain language (not commit-message jargon), then one line "Next:" with a sensible next step inferred from the work. No greetings, no commit hashes.'

steps.run: node -e 'const d = JSON.parse(process.env.DATA); const total = d.commits.reduce((s, c) => ({ files: s.files + c.files, added: s.added + c.added, removed: s.removed + c.removed }), { files: 0, added: 0, removed: 0 }); const lines = ["🧑‍💻 Standup — " + d.repo + " (" + d.branch + ")", "", process.env.TEXT.trim(), "", "Commits since " + d.since + ": " + d.count + " · +" + total.added + " / -" + total.removed + " lines"]; d.commits.slice(0, 15).forEach(c => lines.push("• " + c.hash + " " + c.subject + " (" + c.author + ", " + c.date + ")")); if (d.count > 15) lines.push("… and " + (d.count - 15) + " more"); console.log(lines.join("\n"))'

MSG=$(cat); if [ -n "$LOBSTER_ARG_NOTIFY_CHANNEL" ]; then openclaw message send --channel "$LOBSTER_ARG_NOTIFY_CHANNEL" --target "$LOBSTER_ARG_NOTIFY_TARGET" --message "$MSG" >&2; fi; printf '%s\n' "$MSG"
